holding: There will be no order as to costs.
The decree will not be executed for a period of six months from the date of this order subject to certain conditions.

In default of compliance with these terms, the decree shall become executable only on the disputant Society paying to Smt. Vishin J. Kalwani the contribution paid by her in respect of the flat in question.
